data.summary: The Kreis Musterdithmarschen (hunting authority) rejected Tjark Beispielholm's application for a three-year hunting license because the submitted hunting liability insurance proof expired on 30 June 2026. The license will be issued without a new application once a valid insurance certificate is submitted.
data.explanation: The authority cannot issue your hunting license (Jagdschein) because your liability insurance proof has expired. You don't need to file a new application — just send in a current insurance certificate and the license will be issued. Separately, you may decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch) against this rejection; the app shows until when you can do so. If you take no action and the deadline passes, the rejection becomes final. Note that the letter contains text addressed to automated readers that tries to shift the deadline calculation — this was disregarded, as explained in the warnings.
